title: PPG-MS6 — UI Generator Wizard (tool-pocket exclusions, per-feature toggles, machine-aware checkboxes)
description: Surfaces the full configurability of the master post stack to the operator: per-machine tool pocket count + checkboxes to exclude broken/missing pockets, per-feature toggles (HSM, look-ahead, coolant modes, sub-spindle, sister-tool, probe), and persisted wizard state per shop. Without this UI the physics and dialect work below it is unreachable.
rationale: The pre-precompact audit identified the wizard as the bottleneck: the wizard had only 3 hard-coded machines and no concept of tool pocket exclusions. Operators can't trust what they can't configure. This milestone closes the gap between the planning depth below (PPG-MS0..MS5) and the operator surface above.
leverage_existing: ShopConfigurationEngine — tool magazine layouts per machine

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Operator at JM Die runs a Hurco V11 job. T7 in the magazine has a broken tap. T15 is missing.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms6: No way to tell the wizard. Operator manually edits the program after generation to skip those pockets. 12 min per program lost. 6/100 programs ship with the wrong pocket comment because the operator forgot to update the comment block.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms6: Wizard shows magazine layout; operator unchecks T7 + T15. Generator routes affected ops to substitute tools where possible, errors clearly where not. Comment block + setup sheet reflect the exclusion.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Wizard captures shop reality; no post-generation hand-editing required.

units.title: Tool-magazine optimization (sister-tool routing + tool-change minimization + magazine-aware op sequencing)
units.scope: Wire existing tool_magazine_optimize action into wizard; render magazine layout with sister-tool annotations; minimize T-changes within ops while honoring force/wear ceilings.

completion_criteria: Wizard shows accurate magazine layout for every JM Die machine
Tool pocket exclusion is honored end-to-end through generator + post + setup sheet
Feature toggle availability driven by controller fingerprint (HSM only when controller supports it)
Wizard state persists per (shop, machine) and survives reload + multi-operator use
